=== Airlines and destinations ===
Geraldton Airport has daily regular public transport (RPT) services to and from Perth, provided by [[QantasLink]] using [[Airbus A320 family|Airbus A320]] and [[Fokker 100]] aircraft, and [[Nexus Airlines (Australia)|Nexus Airlines]] with [[De Havilland Canada Dash 8|Dash 8 Q400]] aircraft.
